comments.professor: dsh-ainar-course-model must precede dsh-professor-pane: the pane's whole job is to draw that plugin's four widget documents, and it imports them directly. dsh-web-app must precede both — it brings the web server the pane's route attaches to and the client-module server that serves its browser half.
comments.bundles: The list IS the mount order, and each bundle contributes its own cordis.patch.yml as one layer: dsh-base first (the core rows, and the default model), then dsh-web-app (the browser UI and the web server this sample's route attaches to), then dsh-sample last. Drop dsh-web-app and the tools still mount while the route does not — which is the case index.js waits for webServer to avoid.
comments.dependencies: Empty on purpose. `dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm, which cannot resolve a file:/link: spec whose absolute path contains a space — and this checkout lives under one. The plugin is a dependency of the PROJECT instead, so Node resolves `dsh-sample` from the dsh installation's own node_modules, which is the first place the loader looks.
